caption:
Seven pups. A fresh start. 🐾✈️

Meet the Fall litter: Chester, Oakley, Amber, Rusty, Autumn, Maple and Graham. After the puppies were found in a Long Island parking lot, volunteer pilots helped get them to foster homes, according to a Nov. 17 update shared by Pilots N Paws and Ollie’s Angels Animal Rescue.

A tip of the headset to pilots Kley Parkhurst, Mike and Caitlin, and to the foster families who took the pups in. This is one of the best things you can do with a pilot certificate: help give seven little passengers a better place to land.

Source: Pilots N Paws and Ollie’s Angels Animal Rescue, Nov. 17, 2026.
